reference_scope: The upstream script is executed as a separately checked-out reference. Its REA state-space experiment is not the HVAC simulator and its implementation is not copied into hvac_pid.

execution.dependency_install_policy: When requested, install only the gym/gymnasium adapter packages and their small notifications packages under output/deps; inherit base NumPy, SciPy, matplotlib and CPU torch.

known_upstream_limitations: PG4PI.py has module-level experiment flags and runs on import.
The script does not seed NumPy itself; the isolated runner seeds it before runpy execution.
The reference runner reports execution status and captured artifacts independently; it does not claim numerical replication of the HVAC implementation.
